notes.title: New patch - July 4th
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342702/5ce38aee1d29b1a82b79d30272e59ecd71877444.jpg[/img]A new patch is now available, here's the fixlist.

- Introduced Tests in Managerial career
- Various fixes in Managerial Career
- AI improvement: now AI riders may incur in unforced falls
- Fixed Off-track help being reset
- Fixed missing backfire from several bikes
- Fixed "From rookie to talent" Trophy unlocking conditions
- Fixed weather randomization in Managerial Career
- Fixed wrong riding style selected for online modes

Tests, mentioned in the first point, will let you speed up your R&D by completing specific challenges on given tracks.

Thank you all for reporting issues. Please remember, in case of technical difficulties, that our Customer Support answers here: http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en

notes.title: New patch available now
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342702/73aa413047c3d15203318223e1104d9662a905d8.jpg[/img]Hello everyone, and first of all thanks for reporting and sorry for any inconvenience.
Here is the fixlist for the just released patch.

-Fixed random crash in single player and multiplayer modes.
-Improved stability in multiplayer modes.
-Fixed crash at start on PCs missing proper Media Pack (installing Media Pack still highly recommended).
-Various fixes in Managerial Career: Staff management, Emails, R&D, Activities.
-Improved tyre and bike damage status HUD.
-Improved online stability.

Please keep reporting in case you encounter further issues. Also remember that our Customer Support answers here, and it's the only efficient way for us to track and solve bugs: http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en

Thank you all

notes.title: Out now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342702/9439bda2e4c76dc0a2b8b866d8da42f08185ba3d.png[/img]The day is here at last. 
MotoGP™17 hits the virtual shelves of Steam, and we're as excited as we can be. 
As always, it's been a challenge, and we hope you enjoy the brand new audio, AI, handling, Managerial Career and coop.
Enjoy the game, and let us know what you think!

Don't forget, for general and technical assistance, that our Customer Support answers here: http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en

notes.title: The future is in your wrist
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent-mxp1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t31.0-8/17311220_1135953029864511_3199640348220709974_o.jpg?oh=e46f8ceb8d3829a60e5332935a370518&oe=595A4B5E[/img]

We are happy to announce MotoGP™17, the videogame dedicated to the 2017 world championship season. The game will be available from the15th of June 2017 on Windows PC/STEAM™.

The 2017 edition of the official MotoGP™ videogame brings all the adrenaline and need for speed of the new motorbike world champion with it.
The title will include all the 2017 riders, teams and tracks; the new rules and the Red Bull Rookies Cup championship.
This edition will reach 60 FPS for the first time, guaranteeing unprecedented performance and extreme enjoyability for you!

*screens with 2017 liveries will be coming soon!*

Are you ready to race?

Follow us on
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/motoGPVideogame/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/MotoGPvideogame/
- Website: http://motogpvideogame.com/
